lessons.trigger: A repaired response differs substantively from the response previously audited.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Create a new immutable ID/version and bind every audit/approval receipt to that ID, version, and exact bytes.
lessons.failureCondition: A parent or stale audit authorizes a changed candidate.
lessons.repairAction: Invalidate delivery state and require a fresh audit of the exact current candidate.

lessons.trigger: A reconstruction may introduce defects normalized by its producer.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Use a fresh-context independent auditor; self-critique may supplement but never certify a reconstructed candidate, and the producer context cannot be the auditor context.
lessons.failureCondition: The reconstruction writer or same-context self-critique creates delivery approval.
lessons.repairAction: Return the candidate to reconstructed_pending_audit and dispatch a fresh independent audit.

lessons.source: current owner task + private continuity authority
lessons.trigger: The same handoff packet carries both context and candidate state.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Represent handoff fidelity, candidate-audit fidelity, and reconstruction-audit fidelity separately.
lessons.failureCondition: A green handoff or parent audit is reported as approval of the current reconstruction.
lessons.repairAction: Block delivery and restore distinct gate state in the handoff projection.

lessons.requiredBehavior: Allow no more than two repair cycles, then prefer the smallest discriminating question, explicit uncertainty, or blocked delivery.
lessons.failureCondition: A third repair loop starts or serious uncertainty is silently delivered.
lessons.repairAction: Return DISCRIMINATE_OR_BLOCK and prohibit another reconstruction.

lessons.source: repository AGENTS.md and private continuity contract
lessons.trigger: Candidate text and audit findings can contain private therapy material.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep real candidate/audit bytes encrypted outside Git; commit only generic code and de-identified synthetic evidence.
lessons.failureCondition: Public Git or CI contains real private content or a private-derived digest.
lessons.repairAction: Block push, remove the content from candidate history, and rerun publication audits.

lessons.trigger: The change affects critical encrypted persistence and delivery gates.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Iterate with focused lifecycle/continuity/harness tests, then run therapy lessons, one complete package gate, and exact-head hosted checks.
lessons.failureCondition: A final claim relies on partial or stale verification.
lessons.repairAction: Run the missing final-boundary gate against the exact candidate head.
